title: Vectors: SCHC Adaptation (10 missing, 1 P0)
description:
P0:
- schc_unknown_rule_id_rejection: Rule ID 0xFE or unused must drop, not crash

P1:
- schc_rule7_mqttsn: Rule 7 MQTT-SN wire format, 18-byte compressed
- schc_rule255_uncompressed: 0xFF prefix + full IPv6 round-trip
- schc_port_boundary_compression: port 5679/5680/5695/5696 boundaries
- schc_frag_rule79_direction: B-to-A direction rule
- schc_compressed_size_validation: spec-mandated sizes per rule
- schc_octet_alignment_padding: bit-level padding to octet
- schc_frag_single_active_packet: T=0 one active packet reset

P2:
- schc_rule_version_dio_option: version comparison logic
- schc_frag_ack_bitmap_format: RFC 8724 compressed bitmap
